text: Ebony has a second interview at the architecture firm next Tuesday. She sounded really nervous about the presentation part. She's spent the whole weekend rebuilding her portfolio and says she still isn't happy with it. Her partner is taking her out for breakfast beforehand to calm her down. Remind me to text her good luck on Monday night.
Pick up the dry cleaning before Friday and renew the car tax by the end of the month.
Gustavo's band is playing at the Crown on Saturday. He's on bass now, not guitar.
Called Agnieszka. She didn't get the job at the council, but they said she was a close second and to apply again in early March.
Moira's grandson is running his first half marathon in a fortnight. She's going to stand at the twelve mile mark with a sign.
Need to ask Anders how the interview went on Thursday. He was up against two internal candidates.

Zofia and her husband are doing the Edinburgh Fringe over the summer with their improv group. She said it's a ten-night run at a tiny venue near the Meadows, and they've already sold half the tickets. Her daughter is coming up to help with the lighting.
Salma is vegetarian and doesn't drink. Worth remembering for Friday.
Booked the dentist for sometime next week, they'll confirm by text. Also need to sort the boiler service before it gets cold.
Aisha got the graduate scheme at Rolls-Royce! Starts in September. Must send her a card this weekend.

Wei's recital is tomorrow evening. Her teacher said she's ready, but she's been practising until midnight all week and barely eating. Her mum is flying in from Shanghai for it, which is adding to the pressure. Don't forget to message her after to see how it went.
Ibrahim said the five-a-side final got called off because half the other team have flu. They might replay it end of the month.
Javier mentioned his sister Mabel is applying for nursing jobs in Leeds. She has an assessment day next Wednesday.
Emily's dog Biscuit had his leg operation yesterday. He's home and sulking in a cone. She's taking Friday off to keep an eye on him.
Running the Parkrun on Saturday, then the 10k in early April. Need new trainers before then.
Svetlana's son Kaito has his grade five piano exam this weekend. She's more nervous than he is.
Remind me to ring Jada on Sunday. Her dad is in hospital again and she's been driving up and down the M6 every other day.
Jess loves anything to do with Formula One. Her birthday is in a fortnight, so tickets to the Silverstone museum would go down well.
Esme's play opened last night and apparently it was a disaster: the set collapsed in the second act. Should check how the rest of the run is going later in the week.

Mia has applied for a head of department role at her school. Interviews are sometime next week, but she hasn't heard which day yet. She's up against a colleague she gets on well with, which makes it awkward in the staffroom. She's asked me to do a mock interview with her on Sunday afternoon, so I should dig out some typical questions.
Isabel and Rohan are doing the Three Peaks challenge over the summer for a charity their mum supports. I said I'd sponsor them.
Need to return the parcel to Argos by Thursday, otherwise I lose the refund.
Had lunch with Hemi. He's left the agency and is freelancing now, mostly brand work. He's also learning Portuguese because his partner's family are in Lisbon.
Sinead's choir concert on Friday has been cancelled because the church roof is leaking. They're hoping to rearrange for early December.
Niamh said she's thinking of applying for the PhD in Galway. Deadline is the end of January.
Jun has his citizenship interview next Monday. He's been revising the history booklet every night. I should text him the morning of to wish him luck.

Eva was telling me about her brother Jack's band. They've got a support slot at the Roundhouse next Thursday, which is huge for them. She's going with her parents and a load of cousins, and they've all made T-shirts. Jack apparently hasn't slept properly in days because the setlist keeps changing. Remind me to ask her how it went.
Rachel works nights at the hospital, so don't call before two.
Shira and her wife are moving to Bristol at the end of the month. Their new place has a garden for the cats, Pickle and Fig.
Sunil asked me to be a reference for his application to the civil service. Need to send the form back to him by Wednesday.
Order Mum's flowers, book the train for the weekend, and cancel the gym membership before it renews on the first.
Gustavo's wife Agnieszka is pregnant! Due early May. They told us at dinner.
Spoke to Anders Olsen at the conference. He runs recruitment for a fintech in Oslo and said to send him my CV sometime next week.

Jada's interview at the BBC went well. They said she'd hear back by Friday. Remind me to text her on Saturday if she hasn't said anything. If she gets it, she'd be moving to Salford sometime in the new year, which she's quite excited about. Her flatmate Esme is already looking at rooms up there too.
Ebony mentioned that her mum is having a hip replacement in early February. Ebony will stay with her for a fortnight afterwards.
Moira is a huge rugby fan and never misses a Scotland match. She has a season ticket at Murrayfield.
Phoned Wei after the recital. She played beautifully and the examiner gave her a distinction. She's thrilled.
Spending the weekend clearing out the loft. Tip run on Sunday morning.
Mia got the head of department job! She starts after Easter. Should get her a nice bottle of something to celebrate.
Javier is coaching his daughter's under-tens team. They've got the county cup semi-final next Saturday and he's already lost his voice from shouting at training.

Ibrahim said his wedding in June is off. He and Zofia split up last month. Apparently they're still sharing the flat until the end of the month while she looks for somewhere. He seemed okay but quiet. I must check in with him next week.
Kaito passed his piano exam with merit. Svetlana sent a video of him playing at the café afterwards.
Aisha's brother Rohan has a trial with Exeter City this weekend. She thinks he's got a real chance but he's terrified.
Esme said she has an audition for the Old Vic youth company sometime next week. She's been practising her monologue on her cat, Mabel, who walks out halfway through every time.
Need to finish the cover letter for the Deloitte role by Thursday and ask Emily to read it over.
Hemi's daughter is starting university in Dunedin early next year. He and his partner are flying out with her and staying for a fortnight.
Niamh doesn't like big surprise parties, so keep her fortieth low key. Her husband said a quiet dinner would be best.
Isabel Reyes from the interview panel said they'd make a decision by the end of the week. She also mentioned they're hiring a second analyst over the summer.
Sunil and Rachel's anniversary is on Saturday. Twenty years! They're going to Paris for the long weekend.
Went to see Jack's band last night. Loud, sweaty and brilliant. Ask him for the setlist so I can find the songs.

Jess has had a rough week. She was made redundant on Monday and has a meeting with HR on Friday about the package. Remind me to call her on Friday evening to see how she's doing. She also mentioned she might retrain as a teacher, which she's wanted to do for years.
Mrs Thomas next door is entering her marrows in the village show this weekend. She won second place last year and has been out in the garden at dawn every day.
Remember the MOT on Tuesday, drop the car off by eight. Pick up a prescription on the way back.

Uncle Gustavo is doing a charity swim across Lake Windermere next month. He's seventy-one and has been training at the lido every morning. The family are all going to Bowness to cheer him on, and Aunt Moira is organising a picnic for afterwards. Should sponsor him before the deadline.
Shira told me her son has his driving test on Monday. Fourth attempt. She's not saying a word to anyone so he doesn't feel the pressure.

Salma's job interview was moved from Wednesday to next Friday. She was relieved because it gives her more time to prepare the case study. The panel is four people, including the regional director, so she's nervous. Her brother Ibrahim is lending her his good suit. I'll ask her how it went over the weekend.
Zofia has started running again after her knee surgery. She's aiming for the Great North Run in September.
Thinking about applying for the project manager role that came up internally. Applications close sometime next week, so I need to update my CV over the weekend.
Rohan said Hemi wants a new pair of noise-cancelling headphones for Christmas. He's been dropping hints for weeks.
Quick note: the Jun Nakamura recital is on the fifteenth, not the fourteenth. Tickets are in my email.
